{{Top|leg}}
'''Sunset Cantina''' was a seedy-looking [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was where former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[I-5YQ]] met with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] associate [[Tuden Sal]]. They discussed Pavan's decision regarding Sal's plan to assassinate [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="CN3">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
